record_type_quote: We ran three identical replications. The first two were run on MTurk using the same criteria the original authors used.

targets.title: Product Entitativity: How the Presence of Product Replicates Increases Perceived and Actual Product Efficacy
targets.evidence_quote: This JCR paper contains five studies. We chose to replicate Study 1 (N = 87) because it was the only study run on MTurk.
targets.outcome_quote: As you can see, the original finding did not replicate. Participants did not judge Dettol to be significantly more effective after seeing an add that displayed five (vs. one) bottles of it.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit overall verdict covers the three replications of Study 1.
